svg.title: Living illustration: Picture-book pen and watercolour
svg.desc: Living illustration (2D): the storybook page comes alive and Xandri rides it side-on, left to right, surfing the face of a travelling sand wave under a silver moon. Behind him a wave lip curls over to swallow a rider who slows; prickle bushes and purple vine webs wait ahead to jump. In the top margin his own ink line draws itself toward the small pole of his father's mark.
